rows.text: A person carrying a trashcan meets you. He crouches down and shows you his treasured trashcan.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This is an incredulous space." He beckons. Then, he tosses out some collections of pitiful love poems from the trashcan to make some space for you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In a hushed voice, he says, "Put your waste in it, and the items will evolve into an advanced awareness, then come running out energetically on their own!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Discard 1 Curio and obtain 2 random Curios.
